description: On a runner with Docker: a host whose containers match its reviewed list is healthy; a running container whose Compose project label carries a forged row is counted in the status, named by container name and short id in the diagnostic, alerts only when usrUnlistedAction is Alert, and the label never reaches the output; when docker ps fails but docker info answers (a shim on PATH) the check says it could not run and alerts. A prune installed by an older Host Maintenance is stale and named in the status, before the no-list exit and with or without a list: a script with no version line, a version below the minimum (leading zeros read as decimal), a stamp that is not a whole number, and the version 1 service that runs docker directly alert by default, name what was found, say which component to run, and respect Warn and Ignore; a current prune changes nothing. A host without Docker is Tier 2.

steps.label: One running container on a reviewed list
steps.run: set -e; d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/bin; cp /bin/sleep $d/bin/; for l in $(ldd /bin/sleep | grep -oE '/[^ ]+'); do mkdir -p $d$(dirname $l); cp $l $d$l; done; tar -C $d -c . | docker import - tc-test-sleep:1 >/dev/null; docker run -d --name tc-plain tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600 >/dev/null; mkdir -p /etc/tc-docker; echo name:tc-plain > /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers; echo 'tc-test review' > /etc/tc-docker/reviewed; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}'

steps.label: Healthy
Hostile label: a running container whose Compose project label carries a forged row
steps.run: set -e; INJ=$'x\nstopped-old\t/zz\t\t\t\tfalse\tfalse\tno\t2020-01-01T00:00:00Z\t2020-01-01T00:00:00Z\t'; docker run -d --name innocent --label "com.docker.compose.project=$INJ" tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600 >/dev/null; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}'

steps.label: Hostile label, usrUnlistedAction Warn (default): counted in the status, exit 0
outputContains: STATUS=1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: Hostile label, usrUnlistedAction Alert: alerts, and the diagnostic names it
Hostile label, usrUnlistedAction Ignore: still counted, no alert
Failing Docker: a docker shim that fails docker ps
steps.run: real=$(command -v docker); test "$real" != /usr/local/sbin/docker || exit 1; printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' '# tc-test shim: Docker answers everything except docker ps' '[ "$1" = ps ] && { echo "Error response from daemon: tc-test simulated failure" >&2; exit 1; }' "exec $real \"\$@\"" > /usr/local/sbin/docker; chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/docker; hash -r; docker ps; echo "docker ps exit $?"; docker info --format 'docker info still answers: {{.ServerVersion}}'

steps.label: Failing Docker: the check says it could not run, and alerts
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: Docker did not return its container list

steps.label: Failing Docker: remove the shim
steps.run: rm -f /usr/local/sbin/docker && docker ps >/dev/null && echo 'docker ps answers again'

steps.label: Docker answers again: back to the status with the unreadable count
Stale prune: the list is reviewed and a current prune (version 7) is installed
steps.run: rm -f /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'TC_PRUNE_VERSION=7' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 4 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && cat /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers | tail -n 1 && test -s /etc/tc-docker/reviewed

steps.label: Current prune: no stale text, same status and exit as before
outputContains: STATUS=1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: Stale prune: a newer prune than the minimum (version 8, and 09 written with a leading zero)
steps.run: mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' '# TC_PRUNE_VERSION=3 in a comment is not the stamp' 'TC_PRUNE_VERSION=09' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 4 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune

steps.label: A newer prune is not stale, and a leading zero is not read as octal
outputContains: STATUS=1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: Stale prune: the prune script has no version line (a version 2 or 3 to 6 prune), only a comment that mentions it
steps.run: mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' '# TC_PRUNE_VERSION=7 appears here only in a comment' 'REQUIRED_CONTAINERS=""' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 4 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune

steps.label: No version line, usrStalePruneAction Alert (default): stale, alert, the diagnostic says what to run
outputContains: STATUS=prune on this host has no version (installed before version 7); 1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels
Run Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] on this host

steps.label: Stale prune: stamped version 3
Stamped below the minimum: stale, names both numbers, alert
outputContains: STATUS=prune on this host is version 3, older than 7; 1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels
Run Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] on this host

steps.label: Stale prune: stamped 06 (a leading zero is not octal, and 6 is below 7)
Stamped 06: version 6, older than 7
outputContains: STATUS=prune on this host is version 6, older than 7; 1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: Stale prune: a version line that is not a whole number
A stamp that is not a whole number is stale, and the text is not printed
outputContains: STATUS=prune on this host has an unreadable version (not a whole number); 1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: Stale prune: version 3 prune, and the list exists but is not reviewed
Stale prune and an unreviewed list: both are in the status, the stale prune first, and it alerts
outputContains: STATUS=prune on this host is version 3, older than 7; 1 expected: 1 running

steps.label: Stale prune: review the list again
Stale prune, usrStalePruneAction Warn: named in the status, exit 0, no diagnostic
outputContains: STATUS=prune on this host is version 3, older than 7; 1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: Stale prune, usrStalePruneAction Ignore: not named, exit 0
outputContains: STATUS=1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: A bad usrStalePruneAction is refused
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: usrStalePruneAction must be alert, warn or ignore

steps.label: No list yet and no prune installed (a host Host Maintenance has never run on)
steps.run: rm -f /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && rm -f /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers /etc/tc-docker/reviewed && test ! -e /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers && test ! -e /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && test ! -e /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && echo 'no list, no prune, no unit'
outputContains: no list, no prune, no unit

steps.label: No prune installed and no list: healthy, as before
outputContains: STATUS=No expected-containers list on this host yet; Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] creates it

steps.label: Version 1 layout: the service runs docker system prune itself; no script, no list
steps.run: mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system && printf '%s\n' '[Unit]' 'Description=tc-test prune' '[Service]' 'Type=oneshot' 'ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker system prune --all --force --filter until=168h' > /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && cat /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && test ! -e /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && test ! -e /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers

steps.label: Version 1 layout, no list, usrStalePruneAction Alert (default): stale and alert, before the no-list exit
outputContains: STATUS=prune service on this host does not run /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune (version 1 layout); no expected-containers list on this host yet
Run Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] on this host

steps.label: Version 1 layout, usrStalePruneAction Warn: named in the status, exit 0
outputContains: STATUS=prune service on this host does not run /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune (version 1 layout); no expected-containers list

steps.label: Version 1 layout, usrStalePruneAction Ignore: not named, the no-list status as before
outputContains: STATUS=No expected-containers list on this host yet; Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] creates it

steps.label: Version 2 layout: a script with no version line, the right unit, and no list
steps.run: mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'REQUIRED_CONTAINERS=""' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 4 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system && printf '%s\n' '[Unit]' 'Description=tc-test prune' '[Service]' 'Type=oneshot' 'ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune' > /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && cat /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service

steps.label: Version 2 layout, no list: stale (no version), alert
outputContains: STATUS=prune on this host has no version (installed before version 7); no expected-containers list on this host yet
Run Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] on this host

steps.label: Current layout: version 7 script, the right unit, and no list
steps.run: mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin && printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'TC_PRUNE_VERSION=7' 'exit 0' > /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && head -n 4 /usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune && mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system && printf '%s\n' '[Unit]' 'Description=tc-test prune' '[Service]' 'Type=oneshot' 'ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/tc-docker-prune' > /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service && cat /etc/systemd/system/tc-docker-prune.service

steps.label: Current prune and unit, no list: healthy, as before
outputContains: STATUS=No expected-containers list on this host yet; Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin] creates it

steps.label: Stale prune tests: clean up
Host without Docker says so and is healthy
